Contract Generator.contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::genereateApprovalLetter(id: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		obs: LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstance()->any(o|o.RequestID = id),
		newApprovalLetter: ApprovalLetter
	precondition:
		obs.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let newApprovalLetter: ApprovalLetter in
		newApprovalLetter.oclIsNew() and
		newApprovalLetter.Content = 'ApprovalLetterContent' and
		CurrentApprovalLetter = newApprovalLetter and
		obs.AttachedApprovalLetter = newApprovalLetter and
		CurrentLoanRequest = obs and
		result = true
}
